notes: The input contains tied nonzero absolute differences and one zero difference. zero_method='wilcox' removes the zero difference; method='approx' is explicit because ties and a zero prevent an exact signed-rank distribution in this fixture.

provenance.call: scipy.stats.wilcoxon(x=first, y=second, zero_method='wilcox', correction=False, alternative='two-sided', method='approx')
